red_team_question: Could the observed divergence stem from regulatory NPL reclassification or localized debt-collection moratorium rather than nationwide subprime-style collateral rot?

mechanism_name: Brantlinger bread and circuses bio-cognitive and institutional erosion
interpretation: State reliance on debt-financed consumption subsidies (bread) and limbic/media spectacle (circuses) fails to outpace structural inflation, eroding prefrontal public trust and accelerating bio-cognitive decay (Brantlinger Social Decay / T2SAIM HLI).
red_team_question: Are consumption transfers and social support payments financed by productive real revenue or by inflationary debt issuance that exacerbates underlying living-standard collapse?

interpretation: Rollover/debt-service pressure co-occurs with fiscal cash-flow, hidden-liability, FX, or external-financing stress. It is not a default determination.
red_team_question: Are maturity data complete across central government, SOEs, local government, public banks, and guaranteed entities?

mechanism_name: Thornton malinvestment and time-to-build cycle stress
interpretation: Overextension in long-gestation capital goods / megaprojects and artificial credit expansion enters the time-to-build completion phase as liquidity tightens (Thornton Skyscraper Curse). Malinvestment becomes stranded.
red_team_question: Are construction or capital expenditure surges driven by genuine demographic demand and productive infrastructure, or by subsidized interest rates and speculative prestige projects?

mechanism_name: Desai endogenous credit expansion and Ponzi destabilization
interpretation: Endogenous banking credit creation transitions from hedge to speculative to Ponzi financing (Minsky Moment) masked by mainstream DSGE equilibrium illusions until systemic debt service collapses (Desai Hubris).
red_team_question: Can private sector debtors service their obligations from organic operational cash flows, or are they relying on perpetual rollover, capital appreciation, and monetary accommodation?

interpretation: Asset-quality stress co-occurs with capital/liquidity pressure or debtor distress. It requires regulator and balance-sheet review before any banking-crisis label.
red_team_question: Did an accounting, prudential, NPL-definition, forbearance, or provisioning rule change create the observed movement?

mechanism_name: Sovereign-bank nexus and bailout hostage stress
interpretation: Severe banking distress in an oversized financial system threatens to socialize bank private losses onto the sovereign balance sheet (Talbott Hostage Nexus / Doom Loop).
red_team_question: Does the jurisdiction possess a credible bail-in resolution framework (BRRD / FDIC style) or will public balance sheets be forced into an unconditional 0% haircut bailout?

mechanism_name: Bookstaber non-ergodic fire-sale and liquidity dry-up cascade
interpretation: Non-ergodic cascade where margin calls on leveraged entities force mechanical liquidations (fire-sales), draining market depth and triggering funding liquidity evaporation across network nodes (Bookstaber End of Theory).
red_team_question: Is the liquidity drain a temporary friction in a single collateral asset, or is it cascading across interbank repo markets and creating systemic funding freeze?

interpretation: FX pressure co-occurs with reserve loss, external financing pressure, or sovereign rollover stress. This is a stress pattern, not proof of a currency crisis.
red_team_question: Could the FX movement be a temporary global-risk, valuation, seasonal, or policy-regime event rather than domestic external-financing stress?

interpretation: Several distinct stress families are simultaneously active. This is a prioritization signal for human review, not a formal systemic-crisis declaration.
red_team_question: Do multiple signals genuinely arise from distinct mechanisms, or are they a common shock, common source, or double-counted transformation?
